name: lemnaria-configurator
//scripts: Recursive scripts run with --workspace-concurrency=1 on purpose. Several packages depend on @lemnaria/configurator-domain and each builds it via its own build:deps, so running them concurrently puts multiple tsc processes on the same dist/ and produces spurious 'error type' lint failures on a cold tree.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm gate:boundary && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

//pnpm: overrides.@vercel/blob>undici: @vercel/blob 2.8.0 (the latest, 2.8.2, declares the same) declares undici ^6.23.0 and no release declares a patched floor. 6.28.1 still carries the DoS advisories (one high, one moderate) patched in 6.29.1, so the pin is load-bearing: the declared range admits 6.29.1, but the stale pin held 6.28.1. The pin is exact, like the repo's other overrides, and so stays inside 6.x at the patched floor; widen it to >=6.29.1 <7 if the owner prefers. Drop it once @vercel/blob declares ^6.29.1 or later. overrides.@vercel/cli-config>zod: @vercel/blob 2.8.0 reaches @vercel/oidc 3.8.5 and @vercel/cli-config 0.2.4, which pins zod exactly 4.1.11 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, high, patched in 4.6.6); the latest @vercel/cli-config, 0.3.4, still pins 4.1.11, so no upstream release clears it. The pin moves that one copy to the version the domain package uses. Drop it once @vercel/cli-config pins zod 4.6.6 or later. overrides.postcss>source-map-js: postcss 8.5.23 (via next and next-intl) and 8.5.26 (via vite) declare ^1.2.1 and the lockfile resolved 1.2.1, which carries GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q (high), patched in 1.2.2. The range already admits 1.2.2, so the pin only guards against a stale lockfile; drop it once the lockfile no longer needs it. overrides.next>sharp: next 16.3.8 (also via next-intl) declared sharp ^0.35.4 and the lockfile resolved 0.35.4, which carries GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (high, librsvg), patched in 0.35.5. next 16.4.1 now declares ^0.35.5 itself, so the pin only guards against a stale lockfile; drop it once the lockfile no longer needs it.
